title: console sanity and quality runs tabs; measured elapsed and dev identity in the sanity ledger
target_boundary: apps/atm-bd-console runs tabs and the sanity ledger producers they read
description:
## Goal
`atm-bd console` shows a sanity runs tab and a quality runs tab, newest run on top, so the runs are seen without asking the agent (Rand: "it is the only thing I want to see from sanity agent"). Elapsed is measured, not derived: the Jev client returns it with every call and dev-sanity's LLM spawn is timed; the dev whose work was checked is a column with name and nerd icon; an API failure after three retries is its own kind with its own icon, distinct from a JEV FAIL verdict, and its reason shows in the severity table. Governing text: atm-bd-orchestration #347 (Rand's words verbatim and the data contract in its comments), `dev-sanity.md` 9, 10, 46. Anchors: ANC-073, ANC-074, and the console rendering anchors ANC-017, 019, 020, 023, 024, 025, 026 for every agent name the tabs print.

## Deliverables
1. Sanity ledger row (producers): `jev_client.py` returns `elapsed_s` with every call result; `templates/sanity-run-record.json.j2` and `sanity-run-history` add `dev` (the checked bead's assignee, its ATM identity), `jev_elapsed_s`, `llm_elapsed_s` and `kind` (`verdict` or `API_FAILURE`, with the verbatim error in `error`) to the row; `sanity-run-history` keeps its rule that an identical retry is a no-op and a differing duplicate fails (dev-sanity 46). Rows written before this change read with the new fields absent.
2. `templates/sanity-run-table.md.j2` deleted with its example: the runs tab replaces the table in dev-sanity's chat reply (#347).
3. `runs.py`: reads the phase sanity ledger rows and, for the quality tab, the QA beads of the phase (`bd list -l phase-<x>,stage:qa -n 0 --json`, never `--all`), their `metadata.reviewers` entries (`{reviewer, status, kind, elapsed_s, error, findings}`) and the finding beads with a `discovered-from` edge to the selected QA bead (`metadata.reviewers`, `reviewer`, `severity`, `found_at_commit`); pure functions over the rows, no GitHub call.
4. Sanity tab (`app.py` `TabPane("Sanity", id="sanity")`): one line per run, newest on top: sprint, PR, dev (icon immediately left of the name per ANC-023, chosen by ANC-024/025), JEV verdict icon and elapsed, LLM verdict icon and elapsed, final verdict, iteration; a run of kind `API_FAILURE` draws the API_FAILURE icon in that reviewer's cell and its error appears in the severity table below the list.
5. Quality tab (`TabPane("Quality", id="quality")`): two horizontal panes, top about 60 %: QA runs newest first (sprint, bead, PR, round, verdict, blocking/important/minor counts, elapsed). Selecting a run fills the bottom pane, split vertically: left, one row per reviewer (name, PASS/FAIL icon, elapsed, API_FAILURE icon when it did not run); right, the findings the selected reviewer contributed, rendered as markdown by `templates/qa-findings.md.j2` through `sc_render.render` into a Textual `Markdown` widget (id, severity icon, category, `file:line` refs, issue, required correction, filing reviewer marked, contributing reviewers). Selecting the run row rather than a reviewer shows every finding of the run once.
6. Icons (`icons.py`): the sanity PASS, FAIL and API_FAILURE glyphs and colours, and the dev icon rule, from the layout C table (`/Users/randlee/.config/atm/share/atm-dev/layout-c-icons/`, the codepoint and hex per entry); API_FAILURE is a different glyph from FAIL. Every agent name the two tabs print (the dev, each reviewer) is drawn by the existing `icon_for()` of phase bi, icon immediately left of the name (ANC-023), and the tabs' tests assert these cells: a sanity agent (sanity-jev, sanity-llm, the dev-sanity member) draws U+F01A6 in #E551BA whatever its harness or model (ANC-026, ANC-017); a qa agent (quality-mgr and each reviewer of a QA run) draws U+F029B, in #4A5AF8 while its run is active, #2EA043 after a PASS and #F85149 after a FAIL (ANC-021, ANC-017); every other agent, the dev included, draws its model icon chosen by lower-casing the roster model string and testing it with contains: haiku U+F0156 #FF6533, sonnet U+F0382 #FF784D, opus U+F06C4 #FF8C66, fable U+F0717 #FF9F80 for Claude agents (ANC-019); sol U+F05A8 #FFA60D, luna U+F0F65 #FFE066, terra U+F01E7 #2DE057, astra U+F0674 #FFE066 for Codex agents (ANC-020, ANC-024); no match gives sonnet for a claude-code agent and terra for a codex-cli agent (ANC-025). bj-4 adds no agent-icon rule and no agent glyph; the table above is the one `icons.py` already holds.
7. `docs/requirements/quality-mgr.md`: one item: at close, quality-mgr writes `metadata.reviewers` on the QA bead, one entry per reviewer `{reviewer, status, kind, elapsed_s, error, findings}` measured by a timer around each spawn, and `metadata.reviewers` on each finding bead it files (filing reviewer first). This tab renders the fields when present and shows `-` when absent.
8. Dispatch read order (ANC-061): on every tick `dispatch.py` reads `bd ready` first and `atm task list` second, and assigns a sanity or qa bead only when `bd ready` listed it and the task list read afterwards holds no task with that bead id; a bead whose task the close hook already assigned is never assigned twice. This is atm-bd's half of ANC-052: the hook assigns the sanity task in its own run, and atm-bd assigns only the sanity bead the hook did not reach. The candidate filter stays sanity and qa stages only (ANC-060), and every assign dispatch issues keeps running as the phase lead read from `.atm-bd/phase-<x>.toml` on that one subprocess, with atm-bd's notices still sent as `atm-bd@tool` (ANC-051, unchanged phase-bi behaviour).
9. Tests: ledger rows with and without the new fields; the dispatch read order and the no-second-assign case with injected sources; `API_FAILURE` kind rendering with its icon and reason; newest-first order; the quality tab's reviewer rows and the findings render from fixture beads; `qa-findings.md.j2` strict render with its example vars; `test_tabs.py` covers the two new panes; `test_icons.py` the new glyphs.

## Required Work
- Textual 8.2.8 already ships `textual.widgets.Markdown`; no new dependency. `sc-compose` is the wheel the package already requires (`>= 1.7.0, < 2`), imported through `skills/atm-beads/scripts/sc_render.py`; the console declares the same range, not a pin.
- Every time the tabs print is 24-hour local through the console's one display formatter (ANC-041).

## This Sprint Does Not Close
- The close hook, the stack bead and the sanity-stack agent (bj-1, bj-2, bj-3); the three-retry rule and the LLM timer in `agents/dev-sanity.md` (bj-3): this sprint ships the fields they write and the tabs that read them.
- The OTel export of the same rows (next atm release).
design:
## Public Contract
Sanity ledger row (one per reviewer per run, appended by `sanity-run-history`), new fields:
```json
{"run_id": "...", "reviewer": "sanity-jev", "task": "...", "sprint": "bj-1", "phase": "bj", "pr_number": 351, "iteration": 1,
 "verdict": "PASS", "final_verdict": "PASS", "kind": "verdict", "error": null,
 "dev": "arch-ctm", "jev_elapsed_s": 4.2, "llm_elapsed_s": null, "completed_at": "...", "completed_local": "..."}
```
`jev_client.py`: every result object gains `elapsed_s` (monotonic clock around the HTTP call, retries included).
QA bead `metadata.reviewers[]` (written by quality-mgr; read here): `{"reviewer": "req-qa", "status": "FAIL", "kind": "verdict", "elapsed_s": 212.5, "error": null, "findings": ["<finding bead id>"]}`.
`templates/qa-findings.md.j2`: strict, `required_variables: [findings]`, each finding `{id, severity, category, refs, issue, required_correction, reviewer, reviewers}`.
```python
# runs.py
def sanity_runs(rows: list[dict]) -> list[SanityRun]: ...          # newest first, one per run_id, LLM and JEV merged
def qa_runs(qa_beads: list[dict]) -> list[QaRun]: ...
def reviewer_findings(qa_bead: dict, findings: list[dict], reviewer: str | None) -> list[dict]: ...
```

## Exact Targets
- new `apps/atm-bd-console/src/atm_bd_console/runs.py`, `tests/test_runs.py`, `tests/fixtures/runs/*`, `skills/atm-bd-orchestration/templates/qa-findings.md.j2`, `examples/qa-findings-vars.json`
- edited `app.py` (two `TabPane`s), `icons.py`, `beads_source.py` (QA and finding bead reads), `dispatch.py` (read order), `tests/test_dispatch.py`, `tests/test_tabs.py`, `tests/test_icons.py`, `scripts/jev_client.py`, `scripts/sanity-run-history`, `templates/sanity-run-record.json.j2`, `examples/sanity-run-record-vars.json`, `docs/requirements/quality-mgr.md`, tests under `scripts/tests`
- deleted `templates/sanity-run-table.md.j2`
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] (ANC-073) `atm-bd console --phase <x>` on the fixture ledger shows a `Sanity` tab with one line per run, newest first, with a JEV verdict column, a JEV elapsed column, an LLM verdict column, an LLM elapsed column and a dev column showing the icon then the name; `jev_client.py`'s result carries `elapsed_s` measured around the call; `rg -n "llm_elapsed_s" skills/atm-bd-orchestration/scripts/sanity-run-history templates/sanity-run-record.json.j2` matches.
- [ ] (ANC-073) the `Quality` tab has the runs list in the top pane and, after selecting a run, the reviewer rows on the lower left and the selected reviewer's findings rendered on the lower right by `qa-findings.md.j2` in a `Markdown` widget; selecting the run row shows every finding once.
- [ ] (ANC-074) a fixture row with `kind: API_FAILURE` renders the API_FAILURE glyph, which differs from the FAIL glyph in `icons.py` (asserted by test), and its `error` text appears in the severity table.
- [ ] (ANC-023, ANC-024, ANC-025) `test_tabs.py` asserts the dev cell is `<icon> <name>` with the icon chosen by the roster model rule, sonnet for an unmatched claude-code agent and terra for an unmatched codex-cli agent.
- [ ] (ANC-017, ANC-019, ANC-020, ANC-021, ANC-024, ANC-026) `test_tabs.py` asserts every agent cell of both tabs is produced by `icon_for()` from the roster entry; the diff of `icons.py` against `integrate/phase-bj` adds only the sanity PASS, FAIL and API_FAILURE glyphs and no agent glyph or colour.
- [ ] (ANC-022) `rg -n -w atm-bd-console apps/atm-bd-console/src apps/atm-bd-console/tests plugins` returns nothing: no file invokes an `atm-bd-console` command; the console runs only as the `atm-bd console` subcommand.
- [ ] (ANC-061) `test_dispatch.py` asserts the tick reads `bd ready` before `atm task list` and that a ready sanity bead whose task already exists produces no assign action.
- [ ] (#347) `templates/sanity-run-table.md.j2` does not exist and `rg -n "sanity-run-table" plugins apps` returns nothing.
- [ ] (dev-sanity 46) `sanity-run-history` with the new fields: an identical retry is a no-op and a differing duplicate exits non-zero (tests).
- [ ] `qa-findings.md.j2` renders strictly with `examples/qa-findings-vars.json`; a vars file without `findings` fails the render.
- [ ] `docs/requirements/quality-mgr.md` names `metadata.reviewers` on the QA bead and on finding beads with the fields above.

## Validation
- `just lint` and `just test` in the atm-bd-orchestration worktree (console tests run under `uv run --frozen`).
- `atm-bd console --phase <x>` opened against the fixture ledger and a scratch bd phase, both tabs seen.
